THE UMBRELLA for the direction ruled in docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md (read it first). PCL side: 1,313 lines of repair subs for the 28 token rows; Pl::Parser::_ppi_parse 0.95 s vs a 0.25 s plain PPI parse on Calc.pm.  Upstream: 118 open PRs (101 toddr-bot, April-May 2026, unmerged), 22 merged since 2024 (external humans ARE merged, in release bursts: seven releases 2026-04-23..25, nothing since), our June issues #449 ($$$ref + hex float) and #451 (7%-3) unanswered; the pending PRs touching our rows fix 11 of 77 and do not combine (two conflict; the merge breaks a test plan).

USER CONDITIONS (binding): (1) no patches specific to one PPI version -- ordinary commits on a branch of upstream master, rebased per release; the monkey-patch/subclass layer is OUT; (2) PPI's own tests must not break -- the suite PASSES after every branch commit; (3) docs/ppi-bug-report.t goes into the fork's t/ with the fixes (every failing row in a TODO block; each fix un-TODOs its rows) -- PPI's CLAUDE.md two-commit PR shape.

EXECUTION = brief s527/s527a-prompt.md (IDs 3920-3939): M0 clone + baseline; M1 the test file first; M2 the 12 fixes as groups A-I; M3 vendor/PPI + ONE use-lib bootstrap + PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 + installer/CI/license/README changes; M4 registry fixed_in => 'pcl' + the did-upstream-catch-up canary mode; M5 delete PCL's repairs one per commit with corpus-diff IDENTICAL; M6 measure; M7 the upstream package (fork Percolisp/PPI is the USER's to create; gh unauthenticated here). The expect-state checker (Pl/PPIExpect.pm) stays as the detector of NEW PPI bugs.  Supersedes s526a's token-row half; #3694 1a re-pointed.
